summary: Patch passes the invalid value as a `params={'value': value}` to the invalid_choice ValidationError, matching the pattern already used by ModelMultipleChoiceField and ChoiceField, which is exactly the accepted Django fix. Correct, minimal, and backward-compatible; the default message is intentionally left unchanged so existing translations don't break while the value becomes available to custom messages via %(value)s.

issues.description: Default 'invalid_choice' message string is not updated to include %(value)s, so out-of-the-box error text still doesn't show the value; the param is only surfaced if a user overrides the message. This is the deliberate Django choice (avoid breaking translations), so not blocking, but it means the issue's literal ask is only partially satisfied by default.

No accompanying docs/release-note mention that ModelChoiceField now provides %(value)s for custom invalid_choice messages; a maintainer would typically add a release-note line, but this is docs (not shown) and non-blocking.
